words.sense: the central fictional character whose choices drive the main plot
misconceptions: Assuming the main character must be good.
Assuming anyone admirable must be the main character.

words.sense: a person portrayed as admirable for courage or good deeds, central or not
misconceptions: Assuming the main character must be good.
Assuming anyone admirable must be the main character.

semantic_axes.description: Narrative centrality versus admirable character or action.

edges.boundary_rule: A protagonist is central to the plot regardless of morality; a hero is admirable for deeds even without being the central character.

misconceptions.M1: Assuming the main character must be good.
misconceptions.M2: Assuming anyone admirable must be the main character.
misconceptions.M3: Confusing a performer’s popularity with a character’s function.
